name: WHO Reporting System for Pancreaticobiliary Cytopathology
specimen: EUS-FNA/FNB, cyst fluid, bile duct brushings, ERCP brushings
use: Pancreas solid and cystic lesions, bile ducts, ampulla, gallbladder FNA.

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: No numeric threshold; representative lesional cells or diagnostic cyst contents.
ROSE improves adequacy; cell block for IHC.

categories.name: Insufficient / Inadequate / Non-diagnostic
categories.definition: Non-representative or insufficient material; includes GI contaminant only and acellular cyst fluid without supporting findings.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – pancreas FNAB
WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – bile duct brushings

categories.management: Repeat EUS-FNA/FNB; cyst fluid CEA/glucose/molecular if cyst.
criteria: Acellular cyst fluid with no mucin/biochemistry support.

diagnoses.name: Gastrointestinal contamination only
diagnoses.final: Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic (WHO PB System). Gastrointestinal contamination only.
diagnoses.comment: Not representative of lesion; repeat sampling.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic

diagnoses.name: Acellular cyst fluid
diagnoses.final: Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic (WHO PB System). Acellular cyst fluid.
diagnoses.comment: Interpret with cyst-fluid CEA/glucose and imaging.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Insufficient/Inadequate/Non-diagnostic

categories.name: Negative for malignancy
categories.definition: Benign pancreatic/biliary tissue or specific benign process.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – pancreas FNAB; likely higher in bile duct brushings

criteria: Benign acinar/ductal/islet cells, pancreatitis, pseudocyst, autoimmune pancreatitis, accessory spleen, lymphoepithelial cyst, serous cystadenoma (when diagnostic).

diagnoses.name: Benign pancreatic tissue
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Benign pancreatic tissue.
diagnoses.comment: Correlate with imaging; sampling error possible.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

diagnoses.name: Chronic pancreatitis
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Chronic pancreatitis.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

diagnoses.name: Pseudocyst
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Pseudocyst.
diagnoses.comment: Inflammatory debris, haemosiderin macrophages; high amylase, low CEA.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

diagnoses.name: Autoimmune pancreatitis (suggestive)
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Autoimmune pancreatitis (suggestive).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

diagnoses.name: Serous cystadenoma
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Serous cystadenoma.
diagnoses.comment: Scant cuboidal glycogenated cells; low CEA; usually low cellularity.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

diagnoses.name: Lymphoepithelial cyst
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Lymphoepithelial cyst.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

diagnoses.name: Intrapancreatic accessory spleen
diagnoses.final: Negative for malignancy (WHO PB System). Intrapancreatic accessory spleen.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Negative for malignancy

categories.name: Atypical
categories.definition: Cells with atypia beyond reactive but insufficient for neoplasm/suspicious.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – pancreas FNAB
WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – bile duct brushings

criteria: Atypical ductal/biliary cells; cyst with atypical epithelial cells (grade uncertain).

diagnoses.name: Atypical ductal/biliary epithelial cells
diagnoses.final: Atypical (WHO PB System). Atypical ductal/biliary epithelial cells.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Atypical

diagnoses.name: Atypical cells in cyst fluid
diagnoses.final: Atypical (WHO PB System). Atypical cells in cyst fluid.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Atypical

categories.name: Pancreaticobiliary neoplasm, low-risk/grade (PaN-Low)
categories.definition: Neoplasm with low-grade features: IPMN/MCN with low-grade dysplasia, well-differentiated NET (G1/G2 not routinely gradable), serous cystadenoma.

rom.value: Not captured from WHO book – UNVERIFIED (low-grade atypia cysts ≈4–19%; PSC 'Neoplastic: other' 14.2–100% quoted for comparison)

categories.management: Surveillance or resection per guidelines (Fukuoka/European cyst guidelines, NET protocols).
criteria: Mucinous cyst with low-grade epithelium; thick extracellular mucin.
NET: monotonous plasmacytoid cells, salt-and-pepper chromatin; synaptophysin/chromogranin, Ki-67.

diagnoses.name: Mucinous cyst (IPMN/MCN) with low-grade dysplasia
diagnoses.final: PaN-Low (WHO PB System). Mucinous cyst (IPMN/MCN) with low-grade dysplasia.
diagnoses.comment: Correlate with CEA >192 ng/mL, glucose <50 mg/dL and KRAS/GNAS if available.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – PaN-Low

diagnoses.name: Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumour
diagnoses.final: PaN-Low (WHO PB System). Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumour.
diagnoses.comment: Ki-67 on cell block for grading.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – PaN-Low

diagnoses.name: Serous cystadenoma (neoplastic)
diagnoses.final: PaN-Low (WHO PB System). Serous cystadenoma (neoplastic).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – PaN-Low

categories.name: Pancreaticobiliary neoplasm, high-risk/grade (PaN-High)
categories.definition: Mucinous neoplasm with high-grade dysplasia or features warrant resection; biliary high-grade dysplasia.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text

criteria: Mucinous cyst with high-grade atypia: small cells (<12 µm), high N:C, hyperchromasia, necrosis background.

diagnoses.name: Mucinous neoplasm with high-grade dysplasia
diagnoses.final: PaN-High (WHO PB System). Mucinous neoplasm with high-grade dysplasia.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – PaN-High

diagnoses.name: Biliary epithelium with high-grade dysplasia
diagnoses.final: PaN-High (WHO PB System). Biliary epithelium with high-grade dysplasia.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – PaN-High

categories.name: Suspicious for malignancy
categories.definition: Features suggestive of malignancy, quantitatively/qualitatively insufficient.

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – EUS-FNAB
WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text – bile duct brushings

categories.management: Repeat FNB or proceed per MDT.
criteria: Few cells with malignant features; degenerated.

diagnoses.name: Suspicious for adenocarcinoma
diagnoses.final: Suspicious for malignancy (WHO PB System). Suspicious for adenocarcinoma.
diagnoses.comment: MDT review; repeat sampling if management depends on it.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Suspicious for malignancy

categories.name: Malignant

rom.source: WHO Reporting System (IAC-IARC), 1st ed – book chapter text

criteria: PDAC: 'drunken honeycomb', anisonucleosis ≥4:1, irregular membranes, parachromatin clearing, necrosis.
Acinar cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated NEC, SPN, pancreatoblastoma, metastases, lymphoma.

diagnoses.name: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Cholangiocarcinoma (biliary brushing/FNA)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Cholangiocarcinoma (biliary brushing/FNA).
diagnoses.comment: Correlation with imaging and MDT recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Acinar cell carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Acinar cell carcinoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Neuroendocrine carcinoma (small/large cell)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Neuroendocrine carcinoma (small/large cell).
diagnoses.comment: Correlation with imaging and MDT recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Pancreatoblastoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Pancreatoblastoma.
diagnoses.comment: Correlation with imaging and MDT recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Solid pseudopapillary neoplasm
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Solid pseudopapillary neoplasm.
diagnoses.comment: Low-grade malignant neoplasm: branching papillae with myxoid cores, monotonous cells, nuclear grooves, hyaline globules; nuclear β-catenin, CD10+, LEF1+. Resection recommended.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Metastatic tumour (RCC, lung, melanoma)
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Metastatic tumour (RCC, lung, melanoma).
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

diagnoses.name: Lymphoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant (WHO PB System). Lymphoma.
diagnoses.cat: Diagnostic category: WHO Pancreaticobiliary System – Malignant

extra.title: Change from PSC
items: PSC 'Neoplastic: benign' and 'Neoplastic: other' replaced by PaN-Low and PaN-High.
